images.note: HEAD 200 image/jpeg, 228819 bytes; 1400x937px. Color portrait of Carson by the water, undated (likely 1950s, Maine coast). Fits the script's 'marine biologist already famous for writing about the sea' line and the Silent Spring (1962) beat. Connecticut College item metadata is minimal (title/subject only). alt_url null: the only other qualifying Carson images found are from this same institution, so no different-institution alternate meets the bar.

images.note: HEAD 200 image/jpeg; 4554x5846px. Beat: DDT as 'the agricultural pesticide America had been spraying since the war.' Honest framing: this is a 1949 pro-spraying Pestroy-brand ad, not DDT-branded and not anti-pesticide — it documents the pro-chemical era Silent Spring attacked. alt_url null: CDC PHIL hi-res DDT photos sit behind an ASP.NET postback (unusable); Wellcome's DDT-spraying image is in-copyright and wrong geography.
images.source: Science History Institute, digital.sciencehistory.org (Public Domain Mark 1.0; subject facet: DDT (Insecticide))
images.title: "Farmers Report: More Meat, More Milk, More Eggs after Spraying with Pestroy" (1949 Country Gentleman ad)
